name: @ruviform/ui-showcase
description: Issue #263: design system showcase + verification fixtures — the theme matrix (Reference Light/Dark + product-shape exemplars + custom skin), ruviform-owned demo data and gateways, the standalone showcase page, and headless regression/a11y/cross-consumer tests over @ruviform/ui-components + @ruviform/ui-viz + @ruviform/ui-binding. Plain TypeScript; no UI framework, runtime, or renderer dependency (happy-dom is a test-only devDependency).
